thread:
Alex W: planning sync — we need a concrete migration plan for routing slices before the Dedicated beta customers hit. short window next quarter.
Maria P: agree. main asks from sales: predictable latency, tenant isolation during burst, and a clear rollback story. 
Cheng L: can we reuse the affinity+fallback policy from regional failover? would minimize new surface. @Sofia R any infra blockers? :thinking:
Sofia R: infra: need per-tenant slice tagging in the router, and a safe drain path. current router supports prefer_local + fallback list, but not staged rollouts by tenant slice.
Jamal K: from product: customers want staged migration (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automated rollback if p95 regresses by >10% or error rate >0.2%.
Alex W: good. propose rollout automation with these criteria: 
- stage windows: 30m, 2h, 24h
- metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput
- regression thresholds: p95 +10%, 5xx +0.2pp
- manual hold at each stage

Cheng L: sketch of policy config (proto):
```
traffic_policy:
  slice_selector: "tenant.slice == 'beta'"
  rollout: [10,50,100]
  fallback_order: [region-a, region-b]
  isolation_mode: "soft"
  rollout_checks:
    p95_delta: 0.10
    error_rate_delta: 0.002
```

Sofia R: that looks fine. we need router to record slice decision in traces and tag metrics by slice. otherwise we can't evaluate stage health.
DevOps Bot: deploy queued: router/affinity-v2 -> staging at 2025-11-10T18:00Z
Maria P: add launch criteria to product doc: 
- telemetry: per-slice traces + dashboards
- ops runbook: drain, quarantine, fallback
- SLA guardrails documented for Dedicated

Jamal K: customer negotiation: mention we can offer early migration in exchange for a pilot SLO waiver for first 2 weeks (opt-in). low-risk customers only.
Alex W: ops requirements: 
- canary route must have automatic revert within 5m on anomaly
- rollback action should also trigger a per-tenant quarantine tag to prevent immediate reattempts

Ops Oncall: note — need automation to revoke cache hotness on rollback, otherwise a bad KV cache will keep routing the same.
Cheng L: tech debt: we must support multi-region slice routing state in consistent store. prefer etcd with leader per-slice.
Sofia R: timeline proposal: 
- week 1: routing slice tagging + metrics
- week 2: staged rollout infra + rollout engine
- week 3: canary + runbook dry-run
- week 4: pilot with 2 customers

Maria P: launch checklist draft: ["slice metrics present","rollout engine live","rollback tested","runbook published","legal notice to customers"]
Alex W: Q for team — what is minimal isolation mode for early beta? soft isolation (routing preference + fallback) or hard (tenant-only host pools)?
Jamal K: recommend soft for beta; hard isolation is heavy (cost + capacity planning) and should be gated behind committed Dedicated contracts.
Sofia R: soft isolation + quarantine tags + capacity reservation for hard when customer converts.
Maria P: ok, next actions: 
- @Cheng L add proto config to infra repo
- @Sofia R expose slice metrics dashboard template
- @Jamal K draft pilot SLO waiver wording
- @Alex W schedule runbook tabletop with SRE

Alex W: thanks — syncing this into the product roadmap doc. will post follow-up with PR link.
DevOps Bot: staging deploy successful: router/affinity-v2 @ 2025-11-10T18:03Z :white_check_mark:
Ops Oncall: +1 on dry-run before any customer traffic. schedule for next Tue 14:00UTC.
